title: What came between Kingdom of Portugal and First Brazilian Republic?
question: What came between Kingdom of Portugal and First Brazilian Republic?
claim: 3 documented links lead from Kingdom of Portugal (1139) to First Brazilian Republic (1889): 0 of cause and effect, 3 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
